title: relay's help still calls evidence a merge sha
what: After the evidence check merged (28 Oct), bin/relay's usage and help text (about lines 791 and 988) still say `--evidence <merge sha>`, while the command now wants a commit of the default branch that carries the change (or another repo named).
why: Finding F4 (LOW) of the evidence change's review, not met at its check; the fixer kept bin/relay out of its file list. A help line that names the wrong input sends the next closer to the wrong sha.
pass_cases: The usage and help text name what the check accepts, in the words of lib/relay_queue.py's refusal.
